name: Infected Blood snares enemies taking the Bloodmage's periodic damage (#1258)
contract: Infected Blood 805035's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Infection 800983, a native aura 33 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED with BasePoints -31, TargetA 6 (enemy) and effect mechanic 11 (snare). Spell.dbc gives 805035 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generated no entry and the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Periodic damage dealt now reduces the enemy's movement speed by $800983s1%' at ProcChance 100, so the very first Crimson Tide tick must apply the snare to the unit taking it. Crimson Tide is cast as rank 504134, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h. Its single effect is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE with Amplitude 3000, DurationIndex 8 (15 s) and MaxAffectedTargets 10, so one cast against eight dummies produces 5 ticks x 8 targets = 40 separate PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC events, and two casts 15 s apart produce about 80. Nothing here depends on a proc roll: the record's own ProcChance is 100.
